summary: Every w7 high and medium issue is fixed or mostly fixed. The blue pillow now renders #3f4d9f (q08), 0.87x the back fabric, against tpg_42 #3a53a7 and omaat_room_15 at 0.86x. The pillows are domed two-half lofts that read plump in r7, r9 and q09. The white pillow is the same size as the blue, stands behind it and shows about 7 cm on the aisle side and top, as in omaat_room_15. The E pillows are now square to the seat. The duvet is a draped height field: its folds show as soft shading in r9/r10, the head box is gone, and it narrows past the side table into the footwell as in tpg_72. A Python port of duvetSheet gives a peak cloth top of 0.544 m, under MON.bot 0.555 and the footwell roofs at 0.56, so it does not intersect anything. What remains is mostly detail and proportion. (1) The E mattress (x -0.035..0.495) is narrower than the E seat cushion (x -0.12..0.52), so a 9 cm grey strip of seat fabric shows between the console and the mattress (r10). (2) The duvet has no quilting seams and straight cut edges, where tpg_72 shows a box-quilted comforter with a rumpled diagonal foot. (3) The pillow flange reads as a lavender card under the pillow (r7), because jPillowBack is #595b7e violet-grey; the real flange is warm grey-taupe (omaat_room_15 ~#b0a69d lit). (4) Both white pillows poke 1.5-3.5 cm into the aisle armrest. (5) The monitor bezel's bottom border is now 8 cm against a 5 cm top; tpg_53 measures about 5.3 / 4.7 cm. (6) From above, the central monument is still a flat 0.245 m charcoal block, where c_27313 shows a slim spine with a metal top rail flanked by separate housings. Shell, ash, seat sofa, header band, flap, footwells, tables and controls are unchanged and still match. Score 7.9, up 0.3 from w7: the pillow set is now right and the bed reads as a bed.

issues.detail: E bed mattress is narrower than the E seat, leaving a ~9 cm strip of grey seat fabric between the console and the mattress
issues.problem: In roomBed('E'), mat(-0.035, 0.495, MON.zE - 0.02, 1.28) is one rectangle along the whole bed. The E seat cushion (roomSeatCore w 0.64 at x 0.20) spans x -0.12..0.52, and beside the seat (z > 0.62) the E console face is at x -0.13. The mattress only needs to stay at -0.035 beside E's own table (z < 0.62, band wall at x -0.042..-0.062). r10 shows the uncovered fabric strip (#afabb2, L173) between the console and the white pad. tpg_72 shows the pad running wall to wall beside the seat.
issues.evidence: r10_bedE_close (crop 200-260, 190-300); 09c_room.js roomBed E branch and roomPart E console gRBox(0.45, CON.top, ...) at x -0.355.
issues.fix: 09c_room.js roomBed E branch: replace mat(-0.035, 0.495, MON.zE - 0.02, 1.28) with mat(-0.035, 0.495, MON.zE - 0.02, 0.64) and mat(-0.118, 0.495, 0.62, 1.28). In bounds(), make the outer cloth edge follow it: xl = lerp(lerp(0.02, -0.07, smooth(0.60, 0.68, z)), fl, b), so the white pad still shows about 5 cm at the outer side.

issues.detail: Duvet has no quilting and straight cut edges
issues.problem: tpg_72 shows a box-quilted comforter (stitched channels on a ~0.30-0.35 m grid, puffed between them) with a rumpled diagonal foot edge and the white pad showing as a wedge. duvetSheet() is a smooth satin sheet whose u/v borders are straight lines (z0/z1 constant), so the foot reads as a ruler-cut edge (r9) and the surface reads as a plain sheet.
issues.fix: 09c_room.js duvetSheet fold(): before the edge fade, add quilting dips on a 0.32 x 0.34 grid: const qx = Math.cos(Math.PI * (x - xl) / 0.32), qz = Math.cos(Math.PI * (z - z0) / 0.34); f += 0.008 - 0.012 * (Math.exp(-((qx / 0.12) ** 2)) + Math.exp(-((qz / 0.12) ** 2))). That gives ~1 cm stitched channels with puffs between them. Raise nu 22 -> 32 and nv 40 -> 60 so the channels resolve. For the foot, skew the last 15 % of rows in at(): z = lerp(z0, z1, v) - hd * Math.max(0, (v - 0.85) / 0.15) * 0.12 * (u - 0.3). The foot edge then runs diagonally, ~12 cm longer on the aisle side, as in tpg_72.

issues.detail: Pillow flange reads as a lavender card under the pillow
issues.problem: jPillowBack is #595b7e (violet-grey, L~93), almost the pillow's own tone, so the 1.8 cm rim renders #92a0da beside the pillow's #909edd (r7) and looks like a flat tray. In omaat_room_15 and tpg_72 the flange is a warm grey-taupe band (#b0a69d lit, about 1.3x the pillow), clearly different from the blue. It is also a rigid 8 mm box with 4.5 cm corner radii, while the real one is a soft fabric edge.
issues.evidence: r7_seatO_close crop; omaat_room_15 (720,475) #b0a69d; tpg_72 bottom edge of the blue pillow
issues.fix: 09c_room.js line 18: jPillowBack c '#595b7e' -> '#8c857d' (r 0.75, LAYER.fabric). Line 274 (roomPillow): gRBox(0.456, 0.008, 0.356, 0.045, 1) -> gRBox(0.47, 0.005, 0.37, 0.02, 1) so it is a thinner 2.5 cm band with tighter corners, matching the flange width in omaat_room_15 (~25 px on a 330 px pillow).

issues.detail: White pillows clip into the aisle armrest
issues.problem: The O white pillow is centred at x 0.16, 0.44 wide, so its edge is at x 0.38. The aisle armrest wall starts at ax0 = 0.345, so 3.5 cm of pillow is inside it from y 0.54 to 0.66 (r7: the right edge vanishes into the ledge). The E white pillow at x 0.29 reaches 0.51 against the armrest at 0.495 (1.5 cm).
issues.evidence: roomPart O line 'roomPillow(B, M4.mul(M4.trs(0.16, 0.70, -1.00, Math.PI) ...' and E 'M4.trs(0.29, 0.70, 1.00)'; r7
issues.fix: O: M4.trs(0.16, 0.70, -1.00, Math.PI) -> M4.trs(0.115, 0.70, -1.00, Math.PI). E: M4.trs(0.29, 0.70, 1.00) -> M4.trs(0.265, 0.70, 1.00). Both keep a 4-6 cm aisle-side offset from the blue pillow.

issues.detail: Monitor monument top is a flat 0.245 m charcoal block seen from above
issues.problem: c_27313 (crop 330-640 x 60-420) shows the monument between O and E from above as a slim charcoal spine (~3-4 cm) with a light grey-metal top rail running from the aisle cap inward, flanked by separate housings with dark gaps between. The model's monument body is gRBox(1.13, MON.top - MON.bot, 0.245) with a uniform flat charcoal top, which reads as a broad bar in q09, q10 and r5. The w7 two-fin change went on roomDivider (the centreline wall), not on this monument.
issues.evidence: c_27313 / c_27314 centre vs q09_centrePair (x 530-640), r5_centre_aisle (x 300-390)
issues.fix: roomPart O, monument body: lower the full-depth gRBox top to MON.top - 0.03 (height MON.top - 0.03 - MON.bot). On top of it add a centre spine gRBox(1.13, 0.05, 0.035, 0.008, 1) at (-0.02, MON.top - 0.005, (MON.zO + MON.zE) / 2), shell, with a gRBox(1.13, 0.008, 0.04, 0.003, 1) jPanelEdge rail at y MON.top + 0.022. Add two 0.07-deep face housings gRBox(1.13, 0.03, 0.07, 0.008, 1) at z MON.zO + 0.035 and MON.zE - 0.035, y MON.top - 0.015, which leaves ~3 cm dark gaps (jCavity) either side of the spine. Re-check the cabinet top (1.09) against the housings.
